cases.flareVerification: unsupported: general effect sprites are not attributed to countermeasures

scope: Real saved Lv10 builds, four isolated combat cases, one newly produced helicopter in each mission.
unsupported: Runtime does not expose per-projectile owner or cumulative shots. world.projectiles is concurrent aggregate, sounds includes all game sounds.
MuzzleIndex changes prove that the observed live weapon advanced its firing muzzle, but absence between snapshots does not prove no firing.
No Android ValidationCommand exposes validationCountermeasureBurst or countermeasure count. Efx_Fire/Smoke alone cannot prove a flare; report this as unverified.
A single unchanged muzzle index cannot prove every attached weapon fired.
Finite sampling can miss a short bank or effect; incomplete observations are retained with complete=false, not reported as passed.
